response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per processing run (procgpu / proccpu, using floating-point division) and then averaged. Rows where proccpu is 0 or either value is NULL give a NULL ratio, so AVG ignores them.
A processing run 'matches a site' means an inner join on scanprocessing.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry. Runs with no matching site are dropped.
A NULL entrystat is kept as its own group in the output.
